etfExtraction: Parse Farside public daily historical table only if accessible without circumvention. Verify >= 450 dated rows, first 2024-01-11, last at or before 2026-10-16, at least 2026-10-16 present. Reject duplicates/dates in future/header garbage. Dashes and holiday zero not converted to fabricated positive flow. Summation uses published Total column, do not recalc fund sums.
etfGroupFeature: For completed weekly Sunday t, use ONLY the last 5 and last 20 Farside rows with labeled flow date <= t-9 calendar days (very conservative lookback shift). The source is a CURRENT backfilled table; flag ALL retrospective features as PIT_UNVERIFIED even with this delay. Last 5 positive vs negative and last20 positive vs negative, no optimized thresholds.
investigation: 2024-2026 weekly panel: compare sign of ETF past five-row sum and category N/B/F against next 4w & 13w BTC futures close return median and absolute positive counts. Keep all weekly rows with insufficient history as unavailable, compare unconditional baseline on exact subset. Calendar shift of 9 days is predeclared to avoid accidental new-day flow leakage, not proof of availability.
currentContext: For data cutoff 2026-10-17, Farside published 5 latest dates Oct12-16 and 10 latest dates Oct05-16, show total sums. Fed WALCL Oct14 and weekly delta measured via release published Oct15, but not part of historical model.
statisticalGuard: No p-values, no superiority/profit claims, comparison is explanatory retrospective only
Provenance quality and absence of true vintages forbid SHADOW_VALIDATED, OOS, or trading permission
If remote source unavailable fail closed and write source status with no invented ETF returns
R2 report digest verified from fetched source SHA and versioned analysis JSON
Source archived HTML source hashed but archived raw not republished unless license permits; store parsed numeric series plus metadata only
noTrading: No change Futures, master, live Detector, NAV, Spot, reserve, capital, P&L or limits
